title: Independent verification: all nine frozen PR1264 packing ceilings
body:
PR1240 and the merged PR1264 census share one atanh/Taylor engine for the packing ceilings used in revision 3. This package independently confirms all nine frozen brackets with integer square-root enclosures and reconstructs all fourteen source-profile splits from 21 original pinned JSON blobs. No discrepancy or new kappa is claimed.

Only `research/independent-queue-ceilings/` is added. The implementation imports no predecessor numerical or extraction code. All 18 strict endpoint signs pass at 96/192 exponent/fractional bits and again at 128/256 bits. The original common cap `kappa < 0.001687314840` is corroborated under its existing coverage-law and balanced-transfer assumptions.

The source audit explicitly distinguishes ten direct live-stock fields from four values inferred using `W = 896 N / 9` (#1124, #1130, #1178, #1195); every N is tied to an original field. W7 retains its exact denominator-333 counts. Replacing them with the README's display rounding changes the lower-endpoint sign, while the predecessor's actual exact certificate passes.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.13:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-queue-ceilings
python3 -I -B research/complex-queue-ceiling-census/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
git diff --cached --check
```

The registered replay and 13 test groups pass, including 14 semantic controls, 2,640 direct algebraic power comparisons, 72 zero-saving child costs, source/receipt corruption, omitted-case controls, and optimized read-only relocation. The retained census and selected-record checks also pass. Hosted CI is separate.

This is an audit of the frozen PR1264 domain, not today's full PR queue or a fresh supplier replay. Operation/frame/owner reconstruction, physical live-stock derivation, native admission, chronological hosting, actual supplier surcharges, outer/bootstrap, precision/tape, all-size, analytic and full Lean obligations remain outside scope. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Started from main `ee055dc44815497927ef618fc985b93c2dcbda2a`, then rebased onto `0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2` with all audited inputs unchanged. Contribution head: `225b334a2449189de6f9d1e2f69a236d43cbbb9b`. Task selector: `independent-moment`, nonce `488b8bb97d866ded02e80a47a4e9d7e1`; TASK records the changed audited object, exact inputs, scope and open question. Final overlap coverage was 740 open PRs and 267 Discussion records with complete pagination; no novelty is inferred from search alone. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1620.

Credit Douglas Colkitt for PR1240/1264 and PR1012 for the coverage law; all fourteen construction authors are preserved individually in README/TASK. Credit arkfx's PR706 and Arham-Tahir64's PR1577 for prior integer-root audit methods, and Arham-Tahir64's PR1605 for independent baseline-bracket coverage in its distinct block-budget study. Prepared by Hanson Sun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
